long_biography.plain_text:
Yousuf Ghanim Mohammad Ahli has repeatedly commissioned substantial building projects in Dubai. A fifteen-storey Al Rigga development brought together Design Center Engineers Consultants and Modern Building Contracting under his private client role. The scheme combined two basement levels, a ground floor, a mezzanine, fifteen upper floors and a gym.

His property interests also include income-producing retail premises. At Mirdif Avenue Mall, Ahli pursued unpaid rent and possible eviction against the tenant of a shop. Ghanim Yousuf Ghanim Mohamed Ahli acted for him under power of attorney. The arrangement placed a representative in charge of a continuing landlord matter, while Ahli remained the named party seeking payment and control of the premises.
